changes: Fixed missing Trade Post production queue. Paid Traders now recruit in solo and online matches; existing saved posts acquire a working empty queue.
Trade Post placement warns about insufficient distance and estimates potential gold per completed trip before purchase.
The hint replaces the existing placement instruction; no extra panel. Building Info explains return trips and cargo risk.
Shared distance and payout rules prevent UI drift. Hints inspect owned active Town Centers, never hidden route occupancy.
Physical/fog errors take priority. Legal near-town placement remains allowed for future expansion.

checks.name: Trader recruitment
checks.scope: All six producer scenes, exact 60W/40G/2-pop transaction, solo/authoritative commands, foreign-owner rejection, one completion, automatic route start, paid queue save/resume and legacy queue-less post migration. Test reproduced the bug before the scene fix. Queue time advanced manually; no sockets or ordinary construction claim.

checks.name: Trade planning
checks.scope: 13 pure rule checks; 21 real placement checks covering TC completion, movement, destruction, ownership, current-map scope, physical/fog priority, no spending and no hidden path queries.

checks.name: Placement regression
checks.scope: 1128 geometry/art checks; 32 bounded visible-space and occlusion checks.

checks.name: HUD and commands
checks.scope: 35 HUD checks at 844x390 and 1280x720, including complete trade text; 25 touch/finite-queue/fixed-speed checks; 22 authoritative resource-rally checks.

checks.name: Trade authority
checks.scope: 52 actual command/simulation/recipient snapshot checks. Controlled route still delivers 39 gold after 41.35 simulated seconds; this is not a human trip-duration observation. This earlier fixture directly spawned Traders and did not test recruitment.

checks.name: Web packaging
checks.scope: 20 shell/packaging tests and 8 Windows build tests. Initial module-style invocation used the wrong Python import path; direct script invocations passed.

checks.name: Public multiplayer
checks.scope: 66 room checks on public WSS, followed by two independent paid Barracks/Warrior clients, replicated combat and clean surrender result/cleanup.

checks.name: Deployment
checks.scope: Two reproducible committed exports, matching Linux server smoke, idle-only guarded activation, matching public bytes and web container restart.

checks.name: Browser acceptance
checks.scope: Paid skirmishes, resource rally, construction, combat/raid response, protected app update, old-save resume, trade preview and actual Trader recruitment.

balance.functional_economy_fix: Recruitment was broken; enabling paid Traders restores the intended renewable-gold option.
balance.observed_baseline_result: 6:07 defeat by Town Center destruction; 1 army unit produced versus 9 AI, with long gaps between browser actions.
balance.observed_followup_result: 5:54 Sacred Site defeat; 2 human army units produced versus 8 AI. The exposed Trade Post was destroyed during paid Trader production.
balance.interpretation: Interaction evidence only. This pass does not establish average match duration, win rate or late-game resource exhaustion.

limitations: No physical-phone or OS-installed PWA lifecycle test. Browser cache/update/save behavior was observed.
The preview is a geometric upper estimate; actual route reachability is checked by the Trader and blocked or destroyed routes may earn nothing.

Browser acceptance observed the repaired purchase on an old saved post; raiders destroyed it before completion. Actual birth, route start and payout were verified in controlled engine fixtures, not this browser match.
No representative match-duration or prolonged finite-resource-depletion sample in this pass. Rate and cost tuning is unchanged; working recruitment restores the intended trade option.
